items.title: GALS GAMING CLUB
items.desc: We hit up escape rooms, VR arenas, and challenge venues like Activate, CUBE Challenges, and VR Vibe. Good for anyone who'd rather move, solve, and compete than sit still.

items.title: GALS ADRENALINE CLUB
items.desc: Waterparks, theme parks, skydiving — if it gets your heart racing, we're probably already planning it.

items.title: GALS THEATRE CLUB
items.desc: We catch plays, musicals, and live shows around the city, plus run our own improv nights. Basically any excuse to be dramatic.
